verdict.rationale: Omnara's docs say agents can use models from OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, or Amazon Bedrock, or a compatible self-hosted model. Custom model endpoints can be configured in the dashboard. Organizations connect providers and grant models to projects, and pricing advertises 'Bring your own model keys for free'. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that BYO keys and self-hosted model endpoints work as documented.
